literal: Shengzong, Part Three
idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Three

literal: In the fifth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on yichou day, broke Shucheng County and unleashed troops to plunder extensively.
idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tonghe, on yichou day of the first spring month, the army broke Shucheng County and let the troops plunder freely.

literal: On dingmao day halted at Wen'an, dispatched men to instruct surrender, they did not listen, then attacked and broke it, wholly killed its able-bodied men, and took the old and young captive.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the court encamped at Wen'an and sent men to call for surrender; when they refused, the army stormed the place, killed all the able-bodied men, and took the old and young captive.

literal: On wuyin day the Emperor returned to Nanjing.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the Emperor returned to Nanjing.

literal: On jimao day attended Yuanhe Hall and greatly rewarded officers and soldiers.
idiomatic: On jimao day the Emperor attended Yuanhe Hall and held a great distribution of rewards for officers and soldiers.

literal: On renchen day went to Hualin and Tianzhu.
idiomatic: On renchen day the Emperor went to Hualin and Tianzhu.

literal: In the second month, on the jiawu new moon, arrived from Tianzhu.
idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon of the second month the Emperor returned from Tianzhu.

literal: In the third month, on the guihai new moon, visited Changchun Palace, admired flowers and fished, bestowed peonies widely on close ministers, and feasted joyfully for several days.
idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the third month the Emperor visited Changchun Palace, enjoyed flowers and fishing, distributed peonies among his close ministers, and feasted for several days.

literal: On dingchou day, because zhaila Jieli of Diju's division had merit in scouting, he was ordered into the imperial cup-bearer langjun roster on attendant duty.
idiomatic: On dingchou day zhaila Jieli of Diju's division was rewarded for scouting merit and assigned to the imperial cup-bearer langjun roster on attendant duty.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on the guisi new moon, visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: On the guisi new moon of the fourth summer month the Emperor went to Nanjing.

literal: On dingyou day the Emperor led the hundred officials to confer on the Empress Dowager the honorific title Sagacious Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive to Fortune, Initiating Transformation, Upholding Heaven Empress Dowager;
idiomatic: On dingyou day the Emperor led the hundred officials in conferring on the Empress Dowager the honorific Sagacious Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive to Fortune, Initiating Transformation, Upholding Heaven Empress Dowager;

literal: When the rite was complete, the ministers conferred on the Emperor the honorific title Utmost Virtue, Expansive Filial Piety, Illustrious Sage, Heaven-Aided Emperor.
idiomatic: When the rite was finished the ministers conferred on the Emperor the honorific Utmost Virtue, Expansive Filial Piety, Illustrious Sage, Heaven-Aided Emperor.

literal: On wuxu day an edict ordered the offices to list meritorious veterans rank by rank for added favor.
idiomatic: On wuxu day an edict ordered the offices to register meritorious veterans by rank and extend added favors.

literal: On guichou day summered at Ice Well for coolness.
idiomatic: On guichou day the court took the summer retreat at Ice Well.

literal: In the sixth month, on the renchen new moon, summoned great ministers to decide general governance.
idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the sixth month the Emperor summoned senior ministers to decide routine affairs of state.

literal: On bingshen day Yelü Su was made Yaozhou prefect.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Yelü Su was appointed Yaozhou prefect.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day, Niela division military commissioner Sageoli had benevolent administration; the people requested he remain; it was granted.
idiomatic: On wuchen day in the seventh autumn month Niela division military commissioner Sageoli had governed well; when the people asked that he stay, the request was granted.

literal: That month, hunted at Pingdi Songlin.
idiomatic: That month the Emperor hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

literal: In the ninth month, on bingxu day, visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the ninth month the Emperor went to Nanjing.

literal: That winter halted there.
idiomatic: That winter the court stayed there.

literal: In the sixth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on gengshen day, went to Hualin and Tianzhu.
idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tonghe, on gengshen day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Hualin and Tianzhu.

literal: In the second month, on dingwei day, Xi King Chouning killed the guiltless man Li Hao; the responsible office debated his rank and requested remission of his offense, ordering him to pay money to support Hao's household; it was granted.
idiomatic: On dingwei day in the second month Xi King Chouning killed an innocent man, Li Hao; the responsible office, weighing his rank, asked that the offense be forgiven on condition he pay compensation to Hao's family; the request was granted.

literal: On jiayin day Datong Army military commissioner and joint associate state counselor Liu Jing retired from office.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Datong Army military commissioner and joint associate state counselor Liu Jing retired.

literal: In the third month, on jiwei day, Xiuge memorialized Song affairs; the Emperor personally reviewed it.
idiomatic: On jiwei day in the third month Xiuge reported on affairs with Song; the Emperor read the memorial himself.

literal: On bingyin day, because Directors of Astronomy Zhao Zongde, Qi Tai, Wang Shouping, Shao Qi, and Yan Mei had followed the campaigns for four years and said celestial signs and numbers had correspondences, objects were granted in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the Directors of Astronomy Zhao Zongde, Qi Tai, Wang Shouping, Shao Qi, and Yan Mei, who had followed the campaigns for four years reporting that celestial signs matched events, were rewarded according to rank.

literal: On guiwei day Li Jiqian dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Li Jiqian of Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on yiwei day, visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: On yiwei day of the fourth summer month the Emperor went to Nanjing.

literal: On dingyou day Hulishi charged across and startled Han Dewei's horse so that he fell; the Empress Dowager was angry and killed him.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Hulishi galloped across Han Dewei's path and caused him to fall from his horse; enraged, the Empress Dowager had him executed.

literal: On wuxu day visited the residence of Song King Xiuge.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the Emperor visited the residence of Song King Xiuge.

literal: In the fifth month, on guihai day, Southern Chancellery chancellor Yelü Sha died.
idiomatic: On guihai day of the fifth month Southern Chancellery chancellor Yelü Sha died.

literal: In the intercalary month, on the bingxu new moon, Fengsheng Prefecture reported that the Golden Bell Pavilion built by Taizu was damaged and requested repairs.
idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the intercalary month Fengsheng Prefecture reported that the Golden Bell Pavilion built by Taizu had fallen into disrepair and asked that it be restored.

literal: An edict said because of the southern campaign, fearing to overburden the people again, repairs would wait until the army returned.
idiomatic: An edict replied that with the southern campaign underway, further burden on the people was to be avoided; repairs would wait until the army returned.

literal: On renyin day Aslan Uighurs came with tribute.
idiomatic: On renyin day the Aslan Uighurs sent tribute.

literal: On jiayin day the Uwei Yujue division, because their annual tribute of sable and blue rat skins were not local products but all traded from elsewhere to present, requested changed tribute.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the Uwei Yujue division reported that the sable and blue rat skins due as annual tribute were not local products but had to be obtained by trade elsewhere; they asked that the tribute be changed.

literal: An edict ordered from now on to present only cattle and horses.
idiomatic: An edict ordered that henceforth they need present only cattle and horses.

literal: In the sixth month, on guihai day, Tangut Grand Preceptor Alahuan came to court and presented local goods.
idiomatic: On guihai day of the sixth month Tangut grand preceptor Alahuan came to court with local products as tribute.

literal: On yichou day instructed the various circuits' horses and troops to prepare siege equipment for the southern campaign.
idiomatic: On yichou day an edict ordered the various circuits to ready horses, troops, and siege equipment for the southern campaign.

literal: On yiyou day yilibi Arubu returned Sha Prefecture military commissioner Cao Gongshun and was granted yuyue.
idiomatic: On yiyou day yilibi Arubu escorted Sha Prefecture military commissioner Cao Gongshun home and was granted yuyue.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingxu day, viewed the market.
idiomatic: On bingxu day in the seventh autumn month the Emperor viewed the market.

literal: On jihai day dispatched Southern Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei to punish the various tribes of the He and Huang regions who disobeyed orders.
idiomatic: On jihai day Southern Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei was sent to punish disobedient tribes along the He and Huang rivers.

literal: Granted war horses to the various armies of Xiuge's and Paiya's divisions.
idiomatic: War horses were granted to the armies under Xiuge and Paiya.

literal: On jiyou day the imperial presence halted at Luo River.
idiomatic: On jiyou day the court encamped at the Luo River.

literal: On renzi day Han Dewei was additionally made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and concurrent director of administrative affairs and chief associate of the Secretariat; Eastern Capital regent and palace attendant, Qishui Commandery King Yelü Mozhi was made Datong Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On renzi day Han Dewei was promoted to Kaifu Yitong Sansi with concurrent director of administrative affairs and chief associate of the Secretariat; Eastern Capital regent, palace attendant, and Qishui Commandery King Yelü Mozhi was made Datong Army military commissioner.

literal: On guichou day Paiya requested adding post stations at Zhuo Prefecture.
idiomatic: On guichou day Paiya asked that post stations be added at Zhuo Prefecture.

literal: In the eighth month, on bingchen day, used a green ox and white horse to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On bingchen day of the eighth month the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: On wuwu day Xiuge with Paiya and Niaolige captured live prisoners; when about to reach Yi Prefecture they encountered Song troops, killed their commander, and returned.
idiomatic: On wuwu day Xiuge, Paiya, and Niaolige went out to take prisoners; nearing Yi Prefecture they met Song troops, killed their commander, and withdrew.

literal: On gengshen day visited the warm springs at Liyuan.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the Emperor went to the hot springs at Liyuan.

literal: On guihai day, because of impending attack on Song, dispatched envoys to sacrifice at Muye Mountain.
idiomatic: On guihai day, with an attack on Song imminent, envoys were sent to sacrifice at Muye Mountain.

literal: On dingchou day coastal Jurchen dispatched envoy Sululi to come to court.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the coastal Jurchen sent envoy Sululi to court.

literal: Northwest Route overseer xiangwen Susage, for attacking the Zheli and Zhuli two divisions, presented captives to the Emperor.
idiomatic: Northwest Route overseer xiangwen Susage, having attacked the Zheli and Zhuli divisions, presented his captives to the Emperor.

literal: Eastern Route yulin Xiao Qinde and army commander Shilao, for defeating Jurchen troops, presented captives.
idiomatic: Eastern Route yulin Xiao Qinde and army commander Shilao, having routed Jurchen forces, presented captives.

literal: Datong Army military commissioner Yelü Mozhi memorialized that this year frost and drought had left food scarce and requested increased price for grain conversion to benefit the poor.
idiomatic: Datong Army military commissioner Yelü Mozhi reported that frost and drought had left the people short of food and asked that grain conversion rates be raised to aid the poor.

literal: An edict granted it.
idiomatic: The request was granted.

literal: Coastal Jurchen dispatched Siluli to come and renew local tribute.
idiomatic: The coastal Jurchen sent Siluli to renew their local tribute.

literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen day, Huage with Zhubugu and Chunguli came with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the ninth month Huage, Zhubugu, and Chunguli sent tribute.

literal: Xiuge dispatched xiangwen Yideli to present captured Song spies.
idiomatic: Xiuge sent xiangwen Yideli with captured Song spies.

literal: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager visited Han Dewei's tent, richly rewarded him, and ordered attending ministers to divide into teams for backgammon to fully enjoy themselves.
idiomatic: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager visited Han Dewei's camp, lavished rewards on him, and had attending ministers divide into teams for backgammon to celebrate.

literal: On wuxu day visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the Emperor went to Nanjing.

literal: On jihai day performed rites at Emperor Taizong's temple.
idiomatic: On jihai day the court offered rites at Emperor Taizong's temple.

literal: Tang Yuande was made Fengling Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: Tang Yuande was appointed Fengling Army military commissioner.

literal: On guimao day sacrificed to flags and drums for the southern campaign.
idiomatic: On guimao day the court sacrificed to the flags and drums before marching south.

literal: On gengxu day halted at Zhuo Prefecture, shot silk letters instructing the city to surrender, they did not listen.
idiomatic: On gengxu day the court encamped at Zhuo Prefecture and shot in silk messages calling for surrender; the city refused.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on yimao day, unleashed troops to attack from four sides.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the tenth winter month the army attacked from all four sides.

literal: When the city was broken they then surrendered; thereupon comforted and instructed their multitude.
idiomatic: The city fell and only then surrendered; the court then reassured the populace.

literal: Imperial son-in-law Xiao Qinde and Grand Preceptor Talan were both struck by flying arrows.
idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Xiao Qinde and grand preceptor Talan were both wounded by arrows.

literal: Qinde was carried in the Emperor's carriage to return.
idiomatic: Qinde was brought back in the imperial carriage.

literal: Learning the Song army had withdrawn, dispatched Xiezhen, Paiya, and others to pursue and attack, greatly defeated them.
idiomatic: When word came that Song forces had withdrawn, Xiezhen, Paiya, and others were sent in pursuit and routed them.

literal: On wuwu day attacked Shadui Post and broke it.
idiomatic: On wuwu day the army took Shadui Post.

literal: On jisi day used black and white sheep to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On jisi day black and white sheep were sacrificed to heaven and earth.

literal: On gengwu day distributed surrendered Song troops into seven commands, titled the Guisheng Army.
idiomatic: On gengwu day surrendered Song soldiers were organized into seven commands as the Guisheng Army.

literal: On renshen day marching staff adviser and Xuanyang Hall academician Ma Dechen said that instructing surrendered Song troops, he feared they would never be usable, and requested all be released and returned.
idiomatic: On renshen day marching staff adviser and Xuanyang Hall academician Ma Dechen argued that the surrendered Song troops would never serve reliably and asked that they all be sent home.

literal: An edict did not grant it.
idiomatic: The request was denied.

literal: On bingzi day Chouning memorialized victory in breaking Lang Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Chouning reported victory at Lang Mountain.

literal: On xinsi day again memorialized defeating Song troops at Yijin Pass.
idiomatic: On xinsi day he again reported routing Song forces at Yijin Pass.

literal: On guiwei day the army advanced to Changcheng Pass; Song Ding Prefecture garrison commander Li Xing came with troops to resist; Xiuge attacked and defeated him, pursuing the flight five or six li.
idiomatic: On guiwei day the army advanced to Changcheng Pass; Song Ding Prefecture commander Li Xing met them with troops; Xiuge routed him and pursued the fugitives five or six li.

literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiashen new moon, because the Emperor was about to attack Changcheng Pass, an edict ordered the various armies to prepare siege equipment.
idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the eleventh month, with an assault on Changcheng Pass imminent, an edict ordered all armies to prepare siege equipment.

literal: On gengyin day encamped at Changcheng Pass and supervised the great army in advancing attack from four sides.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the court encamped at Changcheng Pass and directed a full assault from all sides.

literal: The troops broke the siege and abandoned the city in flight; Xiezhen called them, they did not surrender;
idiomatic: The garrison broke and fled the city; Xiezhen called on them to surrender, but they refused;

literal: the Emperor with Han Dewei intercepted and attacked them, killed and captured nearly all; captives were distributed to serve in the Yan army.
idiomatic: the Emperor and Han Dewei intercepted them, killing and capturing nearly all; survivors were distributed among the Yan armies.

literal: On xinmao day attacked Mancheng and besieged it.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the army attacked and besieged Mancheng.

literal: On jiawu day took its city; soldiers opened the north gate and fled; the Emperor sent men to instruct their officers, and they then led the multitude to surrender.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the city fell; soldiers fled through the north gate; the Emperor sent envoys to their commanders, who then led their men in surrender.

literal: On wuxu day attacked and took Qizhou, unleashed troops to plunder extensively.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Qizhou was taken and the troops were let loose to plunder.

literal: On jihai day took Xinle.
idiomatic: On jihai day Xinle was captured.

literal: On gengzi day broke Xiao Lang Mountain fort.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the army broke the fort at Xiao Lang Mountain.

literal: On dingwei day a thousand Song troops came out of Yijin Pass; imperial maternal uncle langjun Taowei and xiangwen Shige attacked and drove them off, killing one deputy commander.
idiomatic: On dingwei day a thousand Song soldiers sallied from Yijin Pass; imperial maternal uncle langjun Taowei and xiangwen Shige drove them back and killed one deputy commander.

literal: On jiyou day Xiuge presented twenty horses and twenty soldiers taken by Huangpishi xiangwen Xundi in patrolling Mo Prefecture.
idiomatic: On jiyou day Xiuge presented twenty horses and twenty soldiers captured by Huangpishi xiangwen Xundi while scouting Mo Prefecture.

literal: Ordered that surrenderers be granted clothing and belts and made to serve in Yanjing.
idiomatic: Surrendered soldiers were given clothing and belts and assigned to Yanjing.

literal: On xinhai day the western route again sent more than two hundred surrendered soldiers; those who were cold were given fur coats.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the western route sent another two hundred-plus surrendered soldiers; those who lacked warm clothing were given fur coats.

literal: Ma Dechen was made acting head of the Xuanhui Court.
idiomatic: Ma Dechen was made acting commissioner of the Xuanhui Court.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the jiayin new moon, granted war horses to Pishi xiangwen Qide and Tuguli.
idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the twelfth month war horses were granted to Pishi xiangwen Qide and Tuguli.

literal: Horizontal tent langjun Dadali plundered; ordered he be beaten with the staff.
idiomatic: Horizontal tent langjun Dadali was found to have looted and was ordered beaten with the staff.

literal: On bingchen day hunted at Sha River.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the Emperor hunted at the Sha River.

literal: Xiuge presented Song spies captured by Xi xiangwen Yelu.
idiomatic: Xiuge turned in Song spies taken by Xi xiangwen Yelu.

literal: On dingsi day dispatched Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Jiyuan and others to reconnoiter Anping.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Jiyuan and others were sent to scout Anping.

literal: Palace Guard Horse Army Office memorialized that in attacking Qizhou and Xinle, squad leaders Liu Zan and thirty others had merit and requested added favor and reward.
idiomatic: The Palace Guard Horse Army Office reported that in the attacks on Qizhou and Xinle squad leaders Liu Zan and thirty others had distinguished themselves and asked for rewards.

literal: That month, the great army encamped in Song territory.
idiomatic: That month the main army encamped inside Song territory.

literal: That year, an edict opened the tribute examination; candidate Gao Ju alone passed.
idiomatic: That year an edict opened the civil examinations; Gao Ju alone passed.

literal: In the seventh year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on the guiwei new moon, the army withdrew.
idiomatic: On the guiwei new moon of the first spring month of the seventh year of Tonghe, the army withdrew.

literal: On wuzi day Song Jibi Fort garrison commander Guo Rong led the multitude to come and surrender; an edict ordered them garrisoned at Nanjing.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Song Jibi Fort commander Guo Rong surrendered with his force; an edict ordered them stationed at Nanjing.

literal: On gengyin day halted at Changcheng Pass.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the court encamped at Changcheng Pass.
